messages:
alex: Heads up — saw a 95th+ tail spike after the 11:07 rollout. Seems correlated with batch fission when KV is cold. Profiling trace attached, short notes below.

maria: Saw the same on canary, +180–250ms on tail for a subset of requests. Might be related to last week's kernel_autoselect tweak.

sanjay: Uploaded the raw traces to s3://perf/5529/; key=canary-11-07.tar.gz

jin: Can you paste the hot trace snippet here?

alex: ```
PROFILE: request_id=xx-5529
phases: prefill(12 tokens)->decode(64 tokens)
batch_before_split=8 -> split_into=[3(prefill),5(decode)]
kernel_selected: slow_matmul_v2 (fallback path)
wall_time: prefill=18ms decode=240ms total=268ms
handshake_wait_ms=72 kv_miss=true
```

tyler: Noted: handshake_wait looks high when batch splits and decode chooses fallback kernel. We dropped token_budget.decode to 6 in autoscaler to try to reduce queuing last month.

perf-bot: :warning: Regression detected: model/rlm-13B, region=us-east-1, metric=95th_latency, delta=+23%

maria: Hypothesis: KV miss -> early split -> small prefill batches -> decode merges and kernel selector opts for safe kernel (slow_matmul_v2). That kernel has bad perf for our batch shapes.

sanjay: Quick experiment idea: bump token_budget.decode back to 8 and reduce prefill budget to 3; also bias kernel selector with kernel_hint:prefill->fast_k1 decode->fast_k2.

alex: Ran a 2k-request canary with decode_budget=8, prefill=3, kernel affinity hint applied. 95th dropped ~18%, but avg GPU cycles increased ~3%. Tail improved but cost went up marginally.

jin: Could do phase-aware queues instead: keep separate queues for prefill and decode, with prefill having higher priority but allowing limited decode steal when prefill queue < 2. That keeps prefill latency SLO while preventing decode starvation.

tyler: Also consider KV priming: async KV prefetch for first N requests of a context so subsequent split avoids cold KV. cheap priming might pay for itself on tail.

maria: Agree. Steps: (1) add tracepoint for kernel decision checks (RPC add kernel_hint and decision_reason), (2) add metrics batch_fission_rate and handshake_wait_ms per kernel, (3) experiment with token budgets + two-queue scheduler. 10–20 minute perf runs to validate.

sanjay: I'll add a microbench harness that can replay sampled traces and vary token budgets/kernels. Will also emit per-request kernel_hint and selected_kernel.

alex: Also add a rate-limited background job to probe KV priming for hot contexts (configurable).

perf-bot: Deploy: canary rolling -> nodes=3, job=321.

jin: I'll draft the scheduler PR (phase-aware queues + limited decode steal + config flags). Will include toggle for kernel_affinity hints.

maria: +1. Watch cost: decode budget up -> throughput up -> bill up. Keep perf/run dashboards updated.

alex: Thanks all. I'll attach the canary logs and a short flamegraph when available. Will follow up with a short postmortem if regression persists. :thumbsup:
